title: Machine learning-based risk stratification for moderate-to-severe anxiety-depression in patients with hypertension and/or coronary heart disease: a multicenter cross-sectional study.
summary: Eight machine-learning models risk-stratified moderate-to-severe anxiety-depression (PHQ-9/GAD-7) among 4,006 survey respondents with hypertension or coronary heart disease; the random forest reached test AUROC 0.838 with a Brier score of 0.134, and SHAP identified the associated variables. The study is cross-sectional and self-reported with internal-only validation, and the authors describe it as hypothesis-generating rather than clinically ready.
